engine_note: Measured on a Databricks Lakebase copy-on-write branch with the original harness; the Neon driver was added 2026-09-03. Re-measurable on Neon via steady_state in config/benchmark.yaml.
measurement: CoW read amplification (first-touch vs warm) at GB scale
method: Same laptop client + same branch connection; RTT is common-mode and cancels in the first-touch-vs-warm delta. Absolute ms inflated by laptop->cloud RTT (~300ms).
takeaway: CoW first-touch reads are ~13% slower than warm; the branch is not slower than a fully materialized copy. Read amplification is modest and transient.
